summary: Items to look over, each with a verdict; a viewer can ask their own agent about one item, and the answer comes to their chat with that agent.
notes: The title column is created by the blank template; read its name from databases.list, never assume it.
There is no Actor column: nothing on a row summons an agent. The only way this app reaches an agent is the viewer's own tap on 'Ask my agent about this', which the viewer confirms.
The page never receives the agent's answer. It goes to the viewer's chat with that agent; the viewer sets the Verdict themselves.
